title:
A family owned company
sharing the Georgia we love
intro: At Locate Georgia, we create journeys that go beyond sightseeing. Our mission is to immerse travelers in the real spirit of Georgia — its people, flavors, landscapes, and traditions. We design culturally rich experiences that let you live, eat, and explore like a local, turning every trip into a meaningful, unforgettable adventure.
story:
Locate Georgia began in Tbilisi in 2017, when a small team of friends and family turned years of guiding and hosting into a company of their own. Today we welcome travellers from all over the world, from first-time visitors on a short getaway to groups exploring every corner of the country.

We plan every journey ourselves: the route, the guides, the family-run guesthouses, the wine cellars and the tables where you will share a supra. Because we live here, we know which road is open after the snow, which village is celebrating that week, and which family makes the best khachapuri in the valley.

values_title: What you can expect from us

values.title: Local knowledge
values.text: We were born here. Our guides and coordinators share the places, stories and people they know personally.

values.title: Journeys made for you
values.text: Private or group, five days or two weeks: every itinerary is built around your pace, interests and budget.

values.title: Personal care
values.text: One team looks after you from the first message to the airport farewell, and we are reachable day and night.

values.title: Honest partners
values.text: We work with trusted hotels, drivers, wineries and families across Georgia, many of them for years.

team_intro: The people who will plan your journey and look after you in Georgia.
